name: task_plan
description: Register every accepted real task in Work progress before action or clarification, including a simple request to send a link or file. Supply a concrete short title and actual steps; wait for saved:true before claiming registration. A saved:false work_conflict response identifies activeWorkId; keep that exact automatic-continuation binding and update only its actual task, never unrelated work. Before asking for missing task information, set status to waiting_user with at least one pending step and no inProgress step. Reuse the actual returned workId for semantically related follow-ups across turns, including human-requested revisions to an unaccepted result awaiting review; never guess the latest task. Ordinary conversation and requests only asking for progress create no new task. This records progress only: it never starts another executor, grants permission, or marks execution finished.

status.description: Use waiting_user only when the accepted task needs information from the user. Its steps must contain at least one pending step and no inProgress step; an all-completed plan cannot wait for user input.

name: task_list
description: List saved tasks in this conversation with their actual workId, title, status and completed/total step counts. Use this read-only list to identify the matching task before cancellation; never guess IDs. Listing never executes, restarts, cancels or completes work.

name: task_cancel
description: Cancel an existing task in this conversation by its exact workId when the human requests cancellation or the task is explicitly abandoned or superseded. Supports current acknowledged running/waiting work and saved continuing/waiting_user tasks; the application verifies execution ownership. Paused, failed, review, completed and unconfirmed records require Work progress review. Preserves cancelled history without completing, deleting or starting work. cancelRequested means stopping awaits confirmation; only cancelled:true confirms cancellation.

name: memory_write
description: Update durable reference notes in the VM memory files.

name: send_file
description: Archive a completed file from this conversation output directory.

name: send_message
description: Send text or links to the same chat.

name: react_message
description: Optionally set dant's own single emoji on a real user message when it feels natural. Use sparingly; null removes it. This is independent of user reactions and never task acceptance.

name: credential_find
description: Find saved login/API credentials by name, service, or username. Returns metadata only; use the vault before asking the user.

name: credential_get
description: Read a saved credential for authorized work. The secret is for tool context only: never echo it in chat, memory, or files.

name: credential_request
description: Ask for a missing credential through the separate secure form, never through chat. Waits for the user to save it and returns metadata only.

name: credential_store
description: Save or update a credential in the encrypted VM vault. Never copy credential values to chat, memory, or ordinary files.

name: skill_list
description: List reusable dant-managed skills in this VM workspace.

name: skill_get
description: Read a managed skill and its supporting files before applying or improving it.

name: skill_save
description: Save a generalizable reusable skill with self-contained SKILL.md and scripts/references/assets. Include actual helper source, tests, licenses, package manifests and lockfiles under the skill directory; use relative paths, never external workspace helpers. Omit files to preserve existing files; supplying files replaces the entire supporting file map. Keep secrets in the credential vault. Validate helpers before claiming readiness.

name: create_voice_message
description: Create and deliver an actual spoken audio file in the same chat.

name: schedule_list
description: List saved one-time or recurring tasks, their IDs, priorities, next execution times and state. Listing does not execute them.

name: schedule_save
description: Create or update a scheduled task only when requested. One-time tasks require an explicit ISO time with offset; recurring tasks require a requested five-field cron expression. Supply an IANA timeZone and optional high, normal or low priority. Use an existing id for changes and enabled:false to pause. Saving never executes work immediately.

at.description: For a one-time task: an explicit ISO 8601 instant with Z or a numeric UTC offset. Omit at for recurring tasks.

cron.description: A recurring five-field cron expression: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, such as 0 9 * * * for daily at 09:00. Null selects a one-time task.

priority.description: Priority for scheduled runs waiting to start; never interrupts work already running.

timeZone.description: The intended IANA timezone, such as Asia/Kuala_Lumpur. Recurring tasks default to the current settings timezone.

name: schedule_delete
description: Remove a scheduled task only when requested. This does not stop work already dispatched.
